title: Resolve constrained thermal expansion in series rods
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a chain of axially loaded rods with no intermediate external loads. segments contains length_m>0, area_m2>0, young_pa>0, alpha_per_k (signed), delta_temp_k (signed). imposed_extension_m is the signed total end-to-end extension, positive for elongation. All rods share axial force N, positive in tension. Free extension f_i=alpha_i*deltaT_i*L_i and compliance c_i=L_i/(A_i*E_i). N=(imposed_extension-sum(f_i))/sum(c_i), and each segment extension e_i=f_i+N*c_i. Return {"force_n":N,"segment_extensions_m":[e_i,...]} in original order. Empty segments or any nonpositive length, area or Young modulus returns {"error":"invalid_segment"} before calculation. Small-strain linear elasticity is assumed. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-8, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
